result.topic_en: Title page and opening section of Euler's paper on a paradox in the calculus of variations: finding the curve below a horizontal line minimizing the integral of arc element times the square root of depth, where the calculated curve is sometimes not truly minimal or even imaginary.
result.transcription:
16
DE INSIGNI PARADOXO,
QUOD IN ANALYSI MAXIMORUM ET MINIMORUM OCCURRIT.
AUCTORE
L. EULERO.
Conventui exhib. die 31 Maii 1779.
§. 1. In Paradoxon, quod hic sum expositurus, incidi sequens problema resolvens:
Tab. I. Fig. 1. Sub recta horizontali $AB$ describere curvam $EY$, cujus singula elementa $Yy$ si in radicem quadratam distantiae $YV$ ab illa recta multiplicentur, summa omnium horum productorum evadat minima.
Paradoxon autem in hoc consistit, quod pluribus casibus aliae lineae exhiberi possunt, pro quibus ista summa minor reperiatur quam in curva per calculum inventa, etiamsi intra eosdem terminos contineantur. Praeterea vero etiam evenire potest, ut pro certis terminis propositis curva inventa evadat imaginaria, cum tamen pro aliis curvis, intra eosdem terminos describendis, summa illa memorata modo major existere possit, modo minor; ita ut etiam his casibus aliquod minimum locum habere debere videatur.

items.quote: Sub recta horizontali $AB$ describere curvam $EY$, cujus singula elementa $Yy$ si in radicem quadratam distantiae $YV$ ab illa recta multiplicentur, summa omnium horum productorum evadat minima.
items.english: Below the horizontal line AB, to describe a curve EY such that, if each of its elements Yy is multiplied by the square root of its distance YV from that line, the sum of all these products becomes a minimum.

items.quote: Paradoxon autem in hoc consistit, quod pluribus casibus aliae lineae exhiberi possunt, pro quibus ista summa minor reperiatur quam in curva per calculum inventa, etiamsi intra eosdem terminos contineantur.
items.english: The paradox consists in this: in many cases other lines can be exhibited for which this sum is found smaller than for the curve found by calculation, even though they are contained between the same endpoints.

items.quote: Praeterea vero etiam evenire potest, ut pro certis terminis propositis curva inventa evadat imaginaria, cum tamen pro aliis curvis, intra eosdem terminos describendis, summa illa memorata modo major existere possit, modo minor; ita ut etiam his casibus aliquod minimum locum habere debere videatur.
items.english: Moreover it can also happen that for certain given endpoints the curve found becomes imaginary, while for other curves drawn between the same endpoints the said sum can be now larger, now smaller; so that even in these cases some minimum seems bound to exist.
